description: This source file defines JwtUsernamePasswordAuthFilter class, which extends Spring Security's UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter to handle user authentication with JWT tokens, including custom error handling for locked accounts.

classes.name: JwtUsernamePasswordAuthFilter
classes.description: Custom authentication filter for handling username/password login with JWT token generation, error handling for locked accounts.

methods.name: JwtUsernamePasswordAuthFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with authentication manager, JWT configuration, and secret key.

methods.name: attemptAuthentication
methods.description: Parses login credentials from request, creates authentication token, and attempts authentication; handles LockedException.

methods.name: successfulAuthentication
methods.description: Generates JWT tokens upon successful authentication, adds refresh token cookie, and sets authorization header.

methods.name: handleLockedException
methods.description: Handles LockedException by returning a JSON error response with 403 status.
